cohort: The study included 75 neonates with hyperbilirubinemia meeting the phototherapy threshold and 67 healthy neonates as controls.
finding: Neonates meeting the phototherapy threshold showed altered gut microbiota composition with increased diversity, richness, and an elevated abundance of opportunistic pathogenic genera (Escherichia and Klebsiella) while Streptococcus was reduced.
cross-section timing: within one hour before initiating phototherapy
